questions.prompt: Which data model stores the world as a grid of cells?
questions.explain: A raster is a grid of cells, each with a value. Vector data stores points, lines, and polygons.
WGS84 is a datum (and also the name of a geographic coordinate system built on it).

questions.prompt: The EPSG code for WGS84 latitude and longitude is ___.
Put the georeferencing steps in order.
questions.explain: Control points come first, then the transformation fits them, and the residuals show how well it fits.
